title: DNA extraction and Nanopore library prep
author: Bernard Y Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdfqi3mw
materials: Meanwhile, prepare a solution of 380 µL LB, 10 µL Proteinase K, 10 µL 10% SDS, and 2 µL RNase A in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube. DNA LoBind tubes, 1.5 mL (Tubes, Eppendorf, 022431021, 1.5 mL, https://online-shop.eppendorf.us/US-en/Laboratory-Consumables-44512/Tubes-44515/DNA-LoBind-Tubes-PF-56252.html ) Proteinase K Solution (20 mg/mL) RNA grade Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #25530049 10% SDS solution Contributed by users RNase A solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #R6148

Thaw NEBNext repair and dA-tailing mixes and buffers from the Nanopore Companion Module. Mix buffers by vortexing and mixes by flicking. Spin down tubes and keep chilled on ice. NEBNext Companion Module forOxford Nanopore Technologies Ligation Sequencing – 24 rxns New England Biolabs Catalog #E7180S

steps.title: Prepare flies on filter paper
steps.instruction: Place flies on a sheet of filter paper, dab briefly with a Kimwipe to remove excess ethanol, then transfer the flies to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: First Buffer STE incubation
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL Buffer STE (400 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 30 mM EDTA) to the tube, incubate on a platform rocker or rotator at low‑to‑medium speed for 30 min.

steps.title: Second Buffer STE incubation
steps.instruction: Replace the solution with 1.0 mL fresh Buffer STE and incubate again on the rocker at low‑to‑medium speed for 30 min.

steps.title: Remove excess liquid
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue to a new sheet of filter paper and wick off excess liquid.

steps.title: Chill homogenization equipment
steps.instruction: Place the Dounce homogenizer, Homogenization Buffer (HB: 0.1 M NaCl, 30 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 10 mM EDTA, 0.5 % Triton X‑100) and Lysis Buffer (LB: 0.1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 0.1 M NaCl, 20 mM EDTA) on ice.

steps.title: Dounce homogenize flies
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL HB to the flies in the Dounce, then:

substeps.instruction: Dounce 10 strokes with the loose‑fitting pestle A.
Dounce 10 strokes with the tight‑fitting pestle B.
Follow safety notes: wrap the homogenizer base in paper towel, brace against a soft surface, move pestle vertically without twisting, avoid foaming.

steps.title: Transfer homogenate
steps.instruction: Using a P200 pipette with a wide‑bore tip, transfer the homogenate to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Rinse homogenizer
steps.instruction: Rinse the Dounce with 500 µL HB and transfer the rinse to the same tube using a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Pellet fly material
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 2000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Discard supernatant and wipe lipid
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant carefully, then while the tube is inverted wipe any white lipid smear near the lip with a Kimwipe.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in HB
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL HB by vigorous mixing with a wide‑bore tip, then add 100 µL LB and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate at 50 °C for 2–4 h, mixing gently by rocking/inverting every hour (intervals of 1 h). Vigorously shake if material is clumped.

steps.title: Spin down phase‑lock gel tubes
steps.instruction: Spin down 2 phase‑lock gel tubes per sample at 15000 × g, 4 °C for 30 s (optional but recommended).

steps.title: Transfer lysate to phase‑lock tube
steps.instruction: Pipette the lysate/lysis solution into a phase‑lock gel tube using a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: First PCI extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (~600 µL) of Tris‑saturated phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (PCI, 25:24:1, pH 8.0) inside a fume hood, rock at medium speed for 8 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge PCI mix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16000 × g, 4 °C for 8 min to separate phases.

steps.title: Second PCI extraction
steps.instruction: Add another 600 µL PCI to the same tube, rock 8 min, then centrifuge again at 16000 × g, 4 °C for 8 min.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Decant the aqueous (top) layer into a fresh phase‑lock tube, add an equal volume (~600 µL) chloroform, rock at medium speed for 8 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge chloroform mix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16000 × g, 4 °C for 8 min to separate phases.

steps.title: Final aqueous transfer
steps.instruction: Quickly decant the aqueous layer into a fresh 2.0 mL LoBind tube; avoid touching the phase‑lock gel with the tip.

steps.title: Prepare 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Chill 100 % ethanol on ice and dilute with nuclease‑free water to make 1 mL of 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume (typically 50 µL) of 3 M sodium acetate to the extract, swirl gently to mix.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 2–2.5 volumes (typically 1200 µL) cold 100 % ethanol, mix by gentle swirling and rocking; DNA should form a white stringy clump.

steps.title: Transfer DNA clump
steps.instruction: Using a P200 with a wide‑bore tip, quickly transfer the stringy DNA clump to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube (trick: aspirate just above the clump, dispense quickly).

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min to pellet DNA.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While avoiding the pellet, pipette off the supernatant, then add 200 µL 70 % ethanol, swirl gently.

steps.title: Centrifuge after wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min.

steps.title: Remove ethanol completely
steps.instruction: Pipette off the ethanol carefully; briefly spin (~2 s) and use a P10/P20 tip to remove any residual ethanol.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the 200 µL 70 % ethanol wash (steps 27–29) once more.

steps.title: Air‑dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Allow the pellet to air‑dry until it becomes translucent (≈5 min); do not over‑dry.

steps.title: Resuspend in TE
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 65 µL 1× TE buffer, incubate at 50 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Spin and store DNA
steps.instruction: Briefly spin to collect condensation and store the DNA at 4 °C.

steps.title: Long‑term DNA storage
steps.instruction: Keep DNA at 4 °C for at least 1 week; every ~48 h gently mix with a P1000 (10×) then P200 (5×) to prevent over‑shearing.

steps.title: QC DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL aliquots with Qubit and Nanodrop; aim for >75 ng/µL, 260/280 > 1.8, 260/230 > 2.0.

steps.title: Set up repair/end‑prep mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube, combine 30 µL HMW DNA (3000–4000 ng, typically 48 µL total volume with water), 3.5 µL FFPE DNA repair buffer, 3.5 µL end‑prep reaction buffer, 2 µL FFPE DNA repair mix, and 3 µL end‑prep reaction mix; flick gently to mix.

steps.title: Thermal‑cycle repair
steps.instruction: Run in a thermal cycler: 20 °C for 1 h, then 65 °C for 30 min; hold at 4 °C thereafter.

steps.title: Add SRE buffer
steps.instruction: Using a cut‑off P200 tip, transfer the reaction to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 60 µL Short‑Read Eliminator (SRE) buffer, mix quickly with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: First library clean‑up spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10000 × g, room temperature for 30 min; while spinning, prepare 500 µL fresh 70 % ethanol (or 500 µL 1:1 diluted PB).

steps.title: First ethanol/PB wash
steps.instruction: Pipette off supernatant, then add 150 µL 70 % ethanol (or diluted PB) touching the tube wall; mix gently.

steps.title: Centrifuge after wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10000 × g, room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Remove wash supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipette off all supernatant, ensuring the DNA pellet remains.

steps.title: Second library clean‑up
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 39–42 (ethanol/PB wash and centrifugation) once more.

steps.title: Final library elution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 31 µL Elution Buffer (EB, 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0), incubate at 50 °C for 1 h, spin briefly, then store at 4 °C for at least 48 h (preferably 96 h) before sequencing.

steps.title: Thaw ligation reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw AMX, T4 ligase, LNB, and LFB from the NEBNext Nanopore Companion Module and LSK109 kit; keep on ice after brief spin.

steps.title: Ligate adapters – first mix
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL prepared DNA sample, 2.5 µL AMX, and 5 µL T4 ligase to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube; flick gently to mix.

steps.title: Ligate adapters – add LNB
steps.instruction: Add 12.5 µL LNB, mix quickly with a wide‑bore tip (avoid DNA precipitation on the tip).

steps.title: Incubate ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature for 1 h.

steps.title: First post‑ligation spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10000 × g, room temperature for 30 min to pellet DNA.

steps.title: First post‑ligation wash
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, add 100 µL LFB (or SFB or 1:1 diluted PB); do NOT use ethanol.

steps.title: Second post‑ligation spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10000 × g, room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Second post‑ligation wash
steps.instruction: Pipette off all supernatant; repeat the LFB/SFB/PB wash once more.

steps.title: Final library resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 31 µL EB, incubate at 40 °C for 1 h, spin briefly, then store at 4 °C for at least 48 h before sequencing.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL of the library with Qubit; proceed only if concentration >40 ng/µL (dilute if >100 ng/µL). Expected total 1000–2000 ng.

steps.title: Dilute library for loading
steps.instruction: Using a cut‑off P200 tip, transfer ~350 ng (≤35 µL) of library to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Add SQB and FB
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of SQB (e.g., 10 µL) and then add FB to bring the total volume to 70 µL (e.g., 50 µL FB).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw 1 tube SQB, 2 tubes FB, and 1 tube FLT; mix SQB and FB by flicking, mix FLT with a pipette, keep all on ice.

steps.title: Prime flow cell and load library
steps.instruction: Follow the official ONT instructions to prime the flow cell, then load the prepared library using a wide‑bore tip; gently pipette‑mix the library before loading.

steps.title: Maintain flow cell during run
steps.instruction: Every 10–14 h, flush the flow cell using the Nanopore Flow Cell Wash Kit (EXP‑WSH003) to clear clogged pores.
